name: sql-smart-complete
description: dbForge-style IntelliSense for SQL Server: schema-aware suggestions, automatic table aliases and foreign-key JOIN suggestions.

sqlSmart.server.description: SQL Server instance, for example localhost, .\SQLEXPRESS or 192.168.1.10,1433.

sqlSmart.database.description: Default database to read metadata from. A USE statement in the script overrides it.

enumDescriptions: SQL Server login with user name and password
sqlSmart.authentication.description: How to log in to SQL Server.

sqlSmart.user.description: SQL Server login name, used when authentication is 'sql'. The password is kept in VS Code's secret storage.

sqlSmart.trustServerCertificate.description: Trust the server certificate without validation.

sqlSmart.defaultSchema.description: Objects in this schema are inserted without the schema prefix.

sqlSmart.schemaPrefix.description: When to insert the schema in front of table and view names.

sqlSmart.alias.enabled.description: Add an automatic alias when a table or view is inserted after FROM, JOIN or APPLY.

sqlSmart.alias.useAsKeyword.description: Insert 'Customers AS c' instead of 'Customers c'.

sqlSmart.alias.onSpace.description: Also add an alias when you type a full table name after FROM/JOIN and press space, without picking it from the list.

enumDescriptions: Prefix columns when the table has an alias or several tables are in the query
Always prefix columns with the alias or table name
sqlSmart.columns.qualify.description: Whether column suggestions insert 'c.Name' or just 'Name'.

sqlSmart.keywordCase.description: Letter case of inserted keywords and built-in functions.
